// Define Candidate Profile and CV Matching Parameters
const candidateProfile = {
  fullName: "Candidate Name",
  email: "candidate@example.com",
  targetRoles: [
    "Full Stack Developer",
    "Software Engineer",
    "Backend Developer",
    "Frontend Developer",
    "AI / Automation Engineer"
  ],
  experienceYears: 3,
  primarySkills: [
    "JavaScript",
    "TypeScript",
    "React",
    "Next.js",
    "Node.js",
    "Python",
    "PostgreSQL",
    "REST APIs",
    "n8n",
    "Docker",
    "TailwindCSS",
    "Git"
  ],
  secondarySkills: [
    "GraphQL",
    "AWS",
    "FastAPI",
    "LangChain",
    "OpenAI API",
    "MongoDB",
    "Redis",
    "CI/CD"
  ],
  preferredLocations: ["Remote", "Worldwide", "US", "Europe", "South Africa"],

return [{
  json: {
    candidateProfile,
    executionDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    executionTimestamp: new Date().toISOString()
  }
}];

// Compiles modern, responsive HTML Daily Job Digest Email const matchedJobs = $input.all().map(i => i.json); const candidate = $('Set Candidate Profile & CV').first().json.candidateProfile; const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }); if (matchedJobs.length === 0) { return [{ json: { subject: `🎯 Daily Job Digest: No New High-Fit Matches (${dateStr})`, htmlBody: `

Daily Job Digest

No new job postings met the ${candidate.minScoreThreshold}% match threshold today. Next scan runs tomorrow at 8:00 AM.

`, totalMatches: 0 } }]; } const highPriorityCount = matchedJobs.filter(j => j.matchScore >= candidate.highPriorityThreshold).length; const avgScore = Math.round(matchedJobs.reduce((acc, j) => acc + j.matchScore, 0) / matchedJobs.length); const jobCardsHtml = matchedJobs.map((job, idx) => `
${job.matchScore}% Match • ${job.matchTier}

${job.role}

🏢 ${job.company}  •  📍 ${job.location}  •  💰 ${job.salary}

Tailored Pitch: "${job.tailoredPitch}"

Why it matches: ${job.fitReasoning}

Key Stack: ${(job.tags || []).slice(0, 6).map(t => `${t}`).join('')}
Apply Now →
`).join(''); const emailHtml = `

🎯 Daily Job Match Digest

${dateStr} • Curated for ${candidate.fullName}
${matchedJobs.length}
Total Matches
${highPriorityCount}
High Priority (80%+)
${avgScore}%
Avg Fit Score
${jobCardsHtml}

⚡ Automated by n8n Job Tracker • All opportunities synced to your Google Sheet database

`; return [{ json: { toEmail: candidate.email, subject: `🎯 Job Digest: ${matchedJobs.length} New High-Fit Roles Found (${dateStr})`, htmlBody: emailHtml, totalMatches: matchedJobs.length, highPriorityMatches: highPriorityCount, averageFitScore: avgScore } }];

parameters.content:
### 🟣 STAGE 1: TRIGGER & CANDIDATE PROFILE
- **Automated Schedule**: Mon–Fri @ 08:00 AM Cron
- **Manual Trigger**: Instant on-demand execution
- **Profile Engine**: Stores candidate target roles, core skills, experience & fit thresholds

### 🔵 STAGE 2: MULTI-SOURCE WEB SCRAPING
- **RemoteOK API**: Desktop browser headers & remote dev filters
- **WeWorkRemotely RSS**: Real-time tech feed parsing
- **Normalization Engine**: Cleans HTML, extracts salaries, tags, and standardizes payload

### 🟠 STAGE 3: DEDUPLICATION ENGINE
- **Google Sheets Lookup**: Reads existing application history
- **URL Hashing / Check**: Filters out already discovered postings
- **Branch Control**: Proceeds only when fresh opportunities are found

### 🟢 STAGE 4: AI CV MATCHING & SCORING
- **Multi-Vector Scoring**: Primary Tech (40%), Secondary (20%), Role Title (25%), Synergy (15%)
- **Fit Scoring (0-100)**: Categorizes jobs by priority tier
- **AI Pitch Generator**: Generates 1-sentence tailored application pitch
- **Threshold Gate**: Enforces minimum qualification filter

### 🟡 STAGE 5: GOOGLE SHEETS LIVE SYNC
- Appends qualified job opportunities to active database
- Stores match score, tech stack, location, salary, tailored pitch & application status

### 🔴 STAGE 6: EMAIL DIGEST & ALERTS
- **Responsive HTML Builder**: Luxury card-based email newsletter
- **Executive Stats**: Total matches, High Priority count, Avg Score
- **Instant Dispatch**: Sends direct application links to candidate inbox
